terms.gloss: a stepsister (the daughter of one’s stepfather)
terms.comment: We have found no single Latin word for it: Latin says whose daughter it is, vitricī fīlia, the stepfather’s daughter, or novercae fīlia, the stepmother’s. Every word is classical; we have found no classical instance of the phrase.

terms.gloss: a stepsister (the daughter of one’s stepmother)
terms.comment: Every word is classical; we have found no classical instance of the phrase.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 385.
